question: In pharmaceutical practice, office alcohol is used that meets the conditions for pharmaceutical use and thus qualifies alcohol:

options.opa: Of 95º or alcohol of 96º that owns to the exit of factory.
options.opb: 95º or 95º alcohol that it has at the factory outlet.
options.opc: Of greater disinfecting and bactericidal power.
options.ope: Of greater disinfecting power although not bactericidal.

analysis: In pharmaceutical practice, the most commonly used alcohol is 95% ethanol (190 proof) or 96% ethanol (192 proof) that meets the requirements for pharmaceutical use. These concentrations are effective for disinfection and sanitization purposes.
